basic_profile.bio: I'm a recent college graduate from Seattle, Washington, interested in digital art and gaming. I spend most of my free time exploring new hobbies like learning calligraphy and collecting Pokemon cards. I'm currently working as a junior graphic designer at a small firm, and I love to unwind by playing video games, especially Propnight. I'm single and often online during evenings and weekends, sometimes late into the night.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, which has equipped me with strong skills in digital arts and creative software. I've been teaching myself calligraphy through online tutorials and practice. Additionally, my interest in gaming has made me knowledgeable about game mechanics and community cultures.
